'''Rich Eagle Ford Mainline (REM)''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/refining-processing/gas-processing/article/17275178/etp-to-expand-eagle-ford-mont-belvieu-gas-ngl-facilities|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is located in Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Energy Transfer LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/refining-processing/gas-processing/article/17275178/etp-to-expand-eagle-ford-mont-belvieu-gas-ngl-facilities|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''400 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''160 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/refining-processing/gas-processing/article/17275178/etp-to-expand-eagle-ford-mont-belvieu-gas-ngl-facilities|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/refining-processing/gas-processing/article/17275178/etp-to-expand-eagle-ford-mont-belvieu-gas-ngl-facilities|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/refining-processing/gas-processing/article/17275178/etp-to-expand-eagle-ford-mont-belvieu-gas-ngl-facilities|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2011<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/refining-processing/gas-processing/article/17275178/etp-to-expand-eagle-ford-mont-belvieu-gas-ngl-facilities|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
